title: Guardian Angel Prayer
text:
Angel of God, my guardian dear,
to whom God's love commits me here,
ever this day be at my side,
to light and guard, to rule and guide.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Angele Dei, qui custos es mei,
me tibi commissum pietate superna,
hodie illumina, custodi, rege et guberna.
Amen.

notes: A simple prayer taught to children to invoke the protection and guidance of their guardian angel. Catholic teaching holds that each person has a guardian angel assigned by God for protection and guidance throughout life.
